text.arabic_uthmani: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ

words.gloss_range: rhetorical did-they-mutually-enjoin frame; locally about alleged peer-to-peer transmission of the prior accusation, not a legal bequest or one-way command
words.root_gloss_range: enjoining, charging, joining, and testamentary instruction; the local Form VI frame selects reciprocal counsel or transmission while preserving inheritance-color as background
words.prose: {{ar:أَتَوَاصَوْا۟}} ({{tr:ʾatawāṣaw}}) opens with a rhetorical question, so the repeated accusation is tested as an already completed coordination claim rather than requested as new information. The Form VI shape makes the imagined transmission lateral: each denier would be both sender and receiver, not a recipient of a single authoritative command. Through the following governed pronoun, the verb reaches back to the accusation in 51:52 and treats it as transmissible content. The root's joining and testamentary instruction range lets the question feel like a chain of inherited counsel, while local grammar keeps the selected sense to mutual enjoining about that accusation. The same mutual-enjoining frame is inverted against moral exhortation (90:17; 103:3) and contrasted with divine top-down enjoining (42:13). Structurally, the verbal question is a complete first beat that sets up the corrective collapse after it, and the opening catch in the sound helps make the challenge audible before the nominal diagnosis arrives.

topics.headline: completed coordination tested as question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah stages the repeated accusation as an already completed coordination hypothesis only to make that hypothesis collapse.
topics.reason: QAC marks an interrogative hamza plus perfect verb, and the attachment evidence notes that the question is immediately corrected by the following contrast.

topics.headline: Form VI makes transmission mutual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the imagined explanation is peer-to-peer reinforcement, not command from one superior source.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form VI, third masculine plural, with reciprocal subject agreement across the collective subject.

topics.headline: verb reaches accusation through governed content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb does not float; it is directed through the next word to the accusation from 51:52 as its content.
topics.reason: The syntactically forced prepositional complement supplies the matter about which the mutual enjoining is asked.

topics.headline: joining and testamentary color retained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the image of an accusation linked and handed along, while the local frame keeps the word from becoming a legal bequest.
topics.reason: The broader root family supports joining and testamentary instruction, but the local Form VI question with a content preposition selects mutual counsel or transmission.

topics.headline: moral mutual-enjoining frame inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a form used for mutual moral exhortation is darkly mirrored when the content becomes accusation (90:17; 103:3), while divine enjoining remains top-down (42:13).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete inter-ayah contrasts, and the local Form VI frame supports comparison without replacing the local accusation content.

topics.headline: verbal beat prepares correction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's engine: a verbal challenge is allowed to stand as a complete beat before the corrective nominal verdict replaces it.
topics.reason: The attachment constraints identify a verbal first clause followed by a contrastive nominal clause.

topics.headline: opening catch sounds the challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening sound and rare reciprocal shape make the coordination hypothesis feel marked before it is rejected.
topics.reason: The phonetic and rarity observations are local to the surface and do not conflict with the grammatical question frame.

words.gloss_range: by, with, or concerning it; locally a governed pronoun pointing back to the accusation in 51:52 as the content of the mutual-enjoining question
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) is small in form but large in reference: its attached pronoun carries the accusation from 51:52 into the question without repeating it. The preposition makes that prior speech the governed matter of the verb, so the imagined coordination concerns the accusation as topic, medium, or instrument rather than as a bare object. Because the preposition and pronoun are fused, the two-label charge becomes one compact discourse unit, keeping the question quick and backward-pointing. Its position at the end of the interrogative beat, with a pause before the corrective particle, seals the hypothesis before it is struck away.

topics.headline: pronoun compresses prior accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word pulls the whole accusation from 51:52 into 51:53 as already identifiable content.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence strongly licenses the suffix as referring to the matter about which mutual enjoining is asked, with translation support linking it to 51:52.

topics.headline: preposition makes content transmissible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is framed as the matter or medium of mutual counsel, not as an independent direct object.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement is syntactically forced as the verb's content link.

topics.headline: compact hinge seals the question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how one fused word compresses the prior charge and closes the question before the corrective turn.
topics.reason: The surface form combines preposition and suffix, and the clause boundary places it immediately before the corrective particle.

topics.headline: two labels become one referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the binary accusation from 51:52 is treated as one discourse object that can be tested for transmission.
topics.reason: The pronoun is under-specified without 51:52, and the local discourse resolves it as the prior accusation rather than as a new object.

words.gloss_range: rather, no; corrective pivot that cancels the coordination premise and introduces the true nominal explanation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governed pronoun that closes the interrogative beat before the corrective particle

words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) is the ayah's hinge, not a loose coordinator. It strikes away the proposed coordination premise and moves the reader to the replacement explanation: the issue is not transmitted conspiracy but a diagnosed people. That shift is structural as well as semantic, because the verse moves from a verbal question to a nominal sentence. The short reset after {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) makes the turn audible, while the whole hamza-to-correction-to-final-predicate sequence converts the puzzle of repeated speech into a settled verdict.

topics.headline: correction cancels the premise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle rejects the coordination hypothesis rather than merely adding a second explanation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment support identify the particle as corrective contrast introducing the true explanation.

topics.headline: question turns into diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from what they might have done to what they are.
topics.reason: The first clause is verbal and interrogative, while the second clause is nominal and contrastively linked.

topics.headline: sound resets the argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact particle as the audible and argumentative reset from challenge to final label.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the local surface and reinforces the syntactically marked discourse pivot.

words.gloss_range: they; explicit independent pronoun resuming the known deniers as subject of the nominal diagnosis
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) gives the correction a visible subject. Instead of leaving the verdict as a floating class label, the independent pronoun pins the diagnosis to the known deniers gathered by the previous discourse. Because it opens a nominal sentence, the shift presents a standing condition rather than a freshly narrated action. The pronoun can compress the historical catalogue into one {{tr:they}}, so many scenes of rejection are drawn into a single diagnosed group. A small nasal sound-link binds the pronoun to the following class noun, reinforcing the compact subject-predicate bond. That same group is then available for the withdrawal command in 51:54, where the pronoun is picked up again.

topics.headline: visible subject for diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is pinned to a visible subject before the classifying noun arrives.
topics.reason: The pronoun is the subject of the nominal sentence, with the following noun predicated of it.

topics.headline: known deniers gathered into they
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun gathers previous and current deniers into one referential group rather than introducing a new audience.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the pronoun as resuming the plural rejecters just questioned, while the CRITICAL rows supply the broader discourse-gathering payoff.

topics.headline: nominal state becomes next target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the diagnosis is presented as a standing identity and immediately becomes the group from whom withdrawal is commanded in 51:54.
topics.reason: The second beat is a nominal clause, and the following ayah resumes the same diagnosed group with a pronoun.

topics.headline: nasal sound binds subject and predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small sound-link that makes subject and predicate cohere in the compact nominal phrase.
topics.reason: The phonetic row concerns the local sequence and does not alter the syntactic subject-predicate parse.

words.gloss_range: a people, a classifiable collective; locally the indefinite nominative predicate naming the deniers as a people-type before the final adjective defines the trait
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, and peoplehood; local noun selects the social collective while standing and reckoning resonances remain secondary
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٌ}} ({{tr:qawmun}}) is the classifying center of the nominal answer. Its nominative predicate role makes the correction say what kind of people they are, and its indefiniteness turns the verdict into a repeatable type rather than one bounded historical nation. As an ordinary Quranic collective label, the social noun absorbs many historical deniers into one readable class while keeping the explanation collective after the coordination theory is rejected: the problem is not an isolated speaker but a body standing together in the same posture. The broader root field can suggest standing and even judgment-standing as resonance, but the local noun selects peoplehood, not the Resurrection as a direct sense. In the surah's own sequence, the word joins earlier people-labels (51:32; 51:46) and the compact people-transgression formula also appears in a small cross-surah family (52:32; 37:30). Its sound then binds tightly to the following adjective, so the people-label and the transgression label land as one diagnostic phrase.

topics.headline: indefinite predicate makes a type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction classifies them as a repeatable people-type before naming the defining trait.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative and indefinite as predicate of the explicit pronoun in the nominal clause.

topics.headline: collective peoplehood replaces conspiracy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the explanation remains collective without needing a transmitted conspiracy; they stand as one social body.
topics.reason: The local noun is the Quran's ordinary social collective label, and its singular collective form fits the following plural adjective.

topics.headline: standing field kept as resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a pressure from standing-together toward standing-for-reckoning, while local grammar keeps the word as the social noun.
topics.reason: The root family includes standing and judgment-related derivatives, but the local form and syntax select a people-label.

topics.headline: people-label joins diagnostic formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this people-label belongs to a local and cross-surah diagnostic pattern rather than an accidental noun-adjective pairing (51:32; 51:46; 52:32; 37:30).
topics.reason: The contextual profiles show the noun commonly takes adjectives, and the CRITICAL rows give concrete local and cross-surah pairing references.

topics.headline: common collective absorbs histories
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a very ordinary Quranic collective noun absorbs many historical deniers into one readable class.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence confirms a high-frequency social collective profile, while the local indefinite predicate makes that profile classificatory.

topics.headline: surah's people labels accumulate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from known pronoun to people-class to defining trait, aligned with the surah's accumulating moral labels (51:32; 51:46).
topics.reason: The local order is explicit subject, indefinite class noun, then adjective, and the CRITICAL rows supply same-surah comparison points.

topics.headline: sound binds people and trait
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that cadence and sparse pairing make the people-label and trait land as one compact verdict.
topics.reason: The rows concern the local noun-adjective surface and the sparse supplied pairing, both compatible with the adjective attachment.

topics.headline: no definite historical nation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun does not dignify one fixed historical nation; it keeps the verdict open as a class marked by the final adjective.
topics.reason: The local noun is indefinite, and the same-surah comparison row supports the moral-label sequence without forcing a definite referent.

words.gloss_range: transgressing, overstepping; locally an active participial plural adjective/predicate defining the people as characterized by exceeded bounds
words.root_gloss_range: overflowing, exceeding bounds, tyrannical transgression, and overwhelming calamity; local participle selects human overstepping while consequence and physical overflow remain resonant

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preceding collective noun that receives the final participial adjective

words.prose: {{ar:طَاغُونَ}} ({{tr:ṭāghūna}}) is the ayah's final diagnostic seal. As an active participle inside the nominal phrase, it does not report one completed act; it presents overstepping as the people's standing trait. Its plural agreement fastens the trait onto the collective noun and treats the group as a rational plurality. The root image of overflowing or exceeding bounds makes the charge more than intellectual error: the deniers spill beyond proper limits. The wider root field links human transgression with physical overflow and overwhelming calamity (69:11; 69:5), while local grammar keeps the word as the human participial label. Within the surah, earlier defiance against command returns as this stronger categorical overstepping label (51:44). The uncommon root and sparse people-transgression pairing make the epithet heavy, and the closing position after {{ar:قَوْمٌ}} ({{tr:qawmun}}) lets transgression, not coordination, be the last explanation carried away. The following withdrawal command in 51:54 can then target the group already diagnosed by this final word.

topics.headline: participle makes transgression a trait
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word diagnoses an enduring participial condition, not one past action.
topics.reason: The local form is an active participle modifying the collective noun in a nominal sentence.

topics.headline: plural agreement fastens epithet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural participle is grammatically tied to the people-label, not floating as an unrelated verdict.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses the final word as the nominative adjective characterizing the preceding noun.

topics.headline: overflow image grounds moral overstepping
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moral diagnosis is pictured as overflowing beyond limits, with physical overflow illuminating the label (69:11).
topics.reason: The root field supports exceeding and overflowing, and the local active participle applies that field to human deniers.

topics.headline: calamity branch adds consequence pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same root field can move from overstepping to overwhelming consequence (69:5), while this word remains the human transgressor label.
topics.reason: The calamity branch is real in the root family, but the local morphology is a masculine plural active participle for human transgressors.

topics.headline: rare label marks extreme people-type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the label belongs to a sparse, weighty people-transgression formula rather than ordinary wrongdoing.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact active-participle form as low-occurrence and often adjectival, with the preceding noun as its dominant partner.

topics.headline: final word carries the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word answers the opening question by leaving transgression, not coordination, as the ayah's closing explanation.
topics.reason: The word closes the nominal answer after the class noun, so its adjective position and ayah-final placement give it the verdict's final force.

topics.headline: heavy sound and next target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavy closing sound binds the epithet to the noun and that the next ayah can withdraw from the group this word has identified (51:54).
topics.reason: The phonetic observations are local to the final surface, and the boundary row's 51:54 connection follows from the diagnosed group.

topics.headline: rebellion motif returns categorically
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah's earlier overstepping scene returns as a stronger categorical label (51:44).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply the same-surah contrast, while local grammar keeps this word as the final adjective rather than a narrative verb.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Apparent coordination is corrected to recurrent transgression.** `و ص ي/B003` supplies mutual exhortation; `ق و م/B001` collective; `ط غ ي/B001` overstepping in rebellion. The interrogative proposes transmission, then *bal* replaces it with shared disposition. The packet supplies the correction; I infer **similar exceeded bounds across groups -> same speech without literal consultation**. Repetition is generated structurally, not necessarily by contact.
2. **Overflow explains cross-generational sameness.** `ط غ ي/B002` supplies overflowing force. The sequence of peoples and the repeated labels allow an exploratory social image: **rebellious excess overflows each local boundary -> analogous collective speech**. This keeps the direct rebellion reading while explaining recurrence without a hidden council.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:54-55 translated the diagnosis into communication strategy: withdraw from entrenched transgression, yet continue reminder where receptive assent can benefit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Convergent speech is generated by shared overflow, not necessarily transmission.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `و ص ي/B003` is “mutual exhortation among people”; fixed `ق و م/B001` is a group; fixed `ط غ ي/B001` is overstepping a bound, while `B002` is “overflowing and overwhelming force.” **Structural cue:** repeated magician/madman labels across prior peoples trigger the question in 51:52; `بل` then corrects its proposed mechanism, and 51:54–58 move through withdrawal, selective reminder, common worship-purpose, refusal of provision from creatures, and divine provision. **Role and abduction:** mutual exhortation would explain copied wording, but the correction assigns causal priority to overflowing disposition; I infer that the same relation to bounds independently produces the same defensive slogan. **Reading change:** resemblance across generations becomes evidence of recurrent causal structure, not proof of a literal intergenerational council.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:54–58 exposed overflow as relational closure: it forces withdrawal from one audience while reminder, worship-purpose, and nonextractive provision remain open to another.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir malın bedelini belirleme işlemini, bu işlemle ortaya çıkan değeri ve tarafların bu değer üzerinde hesaplaşmasını destekler. Bir şeyin yerini tutma düşüncesi kökensel açıklamadır; dalın güncel çekirdeği değer biçme ve belirlenen bedeldir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ekonomik değer biçme ve bedelle sınırlıdır; genel olarak başkasının yerini alma veya temel dayanak değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Belirlenen bedel ile mala değer biçme yapıları ayrılır; kapsam genel değiş tokuşa veya yerini tutmaya genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir malın parasal değerini belirlemek ve bu değerlendirme sonucunda ortaya çıkan bedeldir; tarafların değer üzerinde karşılıklı hesaplaşması da bu alana bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir mala değer biçilir ve bu işlem sonucunda onun bedeli belirlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, malın bedelini değerlendirme yoluyla belirleme ve belirlenen değeri adlandırma çekirdeğinde birleşir; karşılıklı değer hesabı da buna bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Değerlendirme işlemi ile bu işlemden çıkan parasal sonucu birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Değer biçme işlemini ve belirlenen bedeli korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir malın parasal karşılığının değerlendirme yoluyla saptandığı bağlamda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek ve bütünüyle birleşmiş bir ceza türü vermez; aynı biçimi yıkıcı yıldırım veya ceza çığlığı, büyük su baskını ve insanların yıkıma yol açan kendi sınır aşımı olarak ayrı biçimlerde açıklar. Dal, bu yorum farklarını ezici bir yıkım ekseni altında koruduğu sürece kullanılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca zorba kişiyi anlatmaz; yıkıcı olayı veya kimi yorumda yıkıma neden olan sınır aşımını bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın sözlük biriminin kaynaklarda verilen olay ve neden yorumlarını korur; zorba kişi anlamını bu dala taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğu yok eden ezici olay veya yıkıma götüren sınır aşımıdır. Kaynak yorumlarında olay, yıkıcı yıldırım ya da ceza çığlığı veya büyük su baskını olarak; neden ise insanların kendi taşkın davranışı olarak açıklanır.

facets.statement: Ortak eksen, bir topluluğun yok oluşuna bağlanan ezici olay veya nedendir.
Bir yorum, yıkım aracını şiddetli yıldırım ya da ceza bildiren öldürücü çığlık olarak belirler.
Başka bir yorum, sözcüğü insanları yok eden büyük su baskınına gönderme sayar.
Bir diğer yorum, sözcüğü yıkım aracı değil, insanların yıkıma yol açan kendi sınır aşımının adlaşmış biçimi sayar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt aynı kullanım için üç açıklama sunar: öldürücü yıldırım veya ceza çığlığı, yıkıcı büyük su baskını ve insanların kendi sınır aşımı. Bunlar yıkım bağlantısında birleşir, fakat olayın aracı ile yıkımın davranışsal nedeni aynılaştırılmamalıdır.

concept_gloss.text: yıkıma götüren ezici olay veya sınır aşımı
concept_gloss.applicability: Yıkıcı yıldırım, ceza çığlığı, büyük su baskını ve yıkıma neden olan davranış yorumu birlikte söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem yıkıcı olay yorumlarını hem de yıkıma yol açan sınır aşımı yorumunu korur.

error_profile.loses: Büyük su baskını ve insanların kendi sınır aşımı biçimindeki diğer yorumları dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yıkım aracının geniş çaplı ve ezici bir su baskını olarak yorumlandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi pürüzsüz kaya yüzeyini, dağın en yüksek bölümünü ve aynı kökten başka bir biçimle herhangi bir yüksek yeri açıkça sıralar; kayanın kayganlığına yırtıcı kuş pençesinin tutunamaması da pürüzsüzlük niteliğini doğrular. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu üç kullanımı ayrıştırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kaya yüzeyi, dağ doruğu ve yüksek yer adlarıyla sınırlıdır; sınır aşımı, su taşkınlığı ve saptırıcı güç anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ad biçimlerinin üç yer ve yüzey anlamını korur; bunları sınır aşma çekirdeğinden türetmez.

concept_map.definition: Pürüzsüz bir kaya yüzeyi ya da dağın en yüksek bölümüdür; aynı kökten başka bir ad biçimi ise herhangi bir yüksek yeri bildirir. Kaya anlamında yüzey öylesine kaygandır ki yırtıcı kuşun pençesi geri seker.

facets.statement: Adın bir kullanımı, yüzeyi düz ve kaygan olan kaya parçasını bildirir.
Kayanın pürüzsüzlüğü, üzerine konmaya çalışan yırtıcı kuşun pençesini geri sektirecek kadar belirgindir.
Aynı adın başka bir kullanımı dağın en yüksek bölümünü, yani doruğunu bildirir.
Aynı kökten farklı bir ad biçimi, türü belirtilmeyen herhangi bir yüksek yeri bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, pürüzsüz kaya ile dağın doruğunu aynı ad biçiminin iki kullanımı olarak, herhangi bir yüksek yeri ise aynı kökten başka bir ad biçiminin anlamı olarak verir. Yırtıcı kuşun pençesinin geri sekmesi, kaya yüzeyinin kayganlığına ilişkin açıklayıcı örnektir.

concept_gloss.text: pürüzsüz kaya yüzeyi, dağ doruğu veya yüksek yer
